landingMeta.title: HitFactor — Your practical shooting history
landingMeta.description: Import your match result sheets and track your history, stats and progress by discipline. Free.

landing.heroTitle: Your shooting sports history, organized and all in one place.
landing.heroSubtitle: Upload the match results sheet and HitFactor builds your history, your stats and your progress in every discipline. No loose spreadsheets, no keeping score by hand.
landing.howTitle: From the match sheet to your history
landing.howSubtitle: Three steps, once per match. HitFactor does the rest.
landing.step1Body: If the match isn't in HitFactor yet, you upload the match results file. It's read in full: shooters, stages and scores.
landing.step2Body: Find your name in the list and click “It's me”. That result is linked to your account.
landing.step3Body: Every new match adds to your history automatically. You see your placements, your averages and how you're improving.
landing.sharedTitle: One shooter uploads it, everyone benefits
landing.sharedBody: Every match imported into HitFactor becomes available to everyone who took part. Shot a match someone else already uploaded? Don't upload it again: find yourself in the ranking, mark yourself with “It's me” and your results appear instantly.
landing.featuresTitle: Built so you see what matters
landing.featuresSubtitle: HitFactor does the math. You just look at your results.
landing.feature1Body: Every match you've competed in, with date, club, division and final placement.
landing.feature2Body: Hit factor, match %, percentile and averages computed automatically, match by match.
landing.feature3Body: Not just the total: how you did in each stage of the match, with times and scores.
landing.feature4Body: A simple chart showing whether you're trending up, steady or down.
landing.feature5Body: Note which firearm you used in each match and keep track of your shots.
landing.feature6Body: View each discipline separately or all combined in an overall view.
landing.disciplinesTitle: Built for how each one is scored
landing.disciplinesSubtitle: HitFactor understands that not every discipline is measured the same way.
landing.ctaBody: Creating an account takes less than a minute. The first match you import will already show you results.

import.downloadFailed: We could not read the uploaded file.
import.fileByDivisionBody: : match ranking, split into blocks by division.
import.fileCombinedBody: : overall ranking of all divisions in a single file.
import.fileCsvBody: : sheet exported from Google Sheets (File → Download → CSV) with the columns Shooter, Club, Category, Discipline, Hits and Points.
import.fileFatBody: : the “Official Ranking” PDF with the match's overall results (no stages). The discipline is taken from the file name (e.g.:
import.fileFatBodyEnd: ). Since that format doesn't include the match date, we'll ask you for it before finishing the import.
import.fileStageBody: : results of an individual stage. Upload them after importing the overall match.
import.fileSteelBody: (PractiScore iPhone): one file per stage like “Stage Results - By Division”. Upload them all together in the same import — we compute the match overall by summing the stage times. The “Category Leaders” PDFs are ignored (their percentages are per category, not per division).
import.fileWinmssBody: (ipsc.org.ar): historical Practical Shooting files. Upload the "overall" first (creates the match) and then the "stages" to fill in the per-stage details. The match date is taken from the file's print date.

form.minShotsHint: Optional. FBI Shooting is set to 45 automatically. For IPSC, Steel Challenge and Combat Solutions enter the minimum shots per entry. It's used to show 'extra shots' in the detail and to average the shooter's efficiency.
form.dontClose: Don't close the tab until it finishes.

parserError.emptyPdf: Empty PDF: no pages were found.
parserError.unknownPdfFormat: We don't recognise this PDF's format. We support PractiScore PDFs, WinMSS files from ipsc.org.ar, official FAT ranking PDFs, and Steel Challenge reports generated by PractiScore for iPhone.
parserError.multiplePdfsUnsupported: Only Steel Challenge supports several PDFs in one import. Upload the files one at a time.
parserError.missingHeaderRow: The header row was not found (Tirador, Club, ...).
parserError.noWinmssMatchName: Could not extract the match name from the PDF. Is this a valid WinMSS file? Start of the text: "{snippet}"
parserError.noPractiscoreMatchName: Could not extract the match name from the PractiScore PDF. Start of the text: "{snippet}"
parserError.noPrintedDate: Could not extract the date from the PDF (expected 'Printed month DD, YYYY').
parserError.noIsoTitleDate: Could not extract the date from the PDF (expected a title with an ISO date 'YYYY-MM-DD').
parserError.noSteelDate: We could not extract the match date from the PDF. Check that the report starts with 'Steel Challenge' followed by the date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
parserError.fatUnknownDiscipline: We could not determine the discipline of the file «{filename}». The filename has to include the discipline (for example: "resultados-apertura-fbi.pdf"). Valid disciplines: FBI, IPSC, Steel Challenge, Combat Solutions.
parserError.winmssNoRows: The PDF was identified as WinMSS but no result rows could be extracted. Try another file, or let me know the match name.
parserError.practiscoreNoRows: The PDF was identified as PractiScore but no result rows could be extracted.
parserError.fatNoSections: The file was recognised as a FAT ranking but no result sections could be extracted.
parserError.fatNoDivisions: The file is a FAT ranking but we could not map any of its sections to a division of the detected discipline. Sections found: {sections}.
parserError.steelCategoryLeadersOnly: Upload the match's 'Stage Results - By Division' PDFs. 'Category Leaders' on their own are not enough: their percentages are per category and do not carry the division's absolute ranking.
parserError.duplicateStageNumber: The PDF has two stages numbered {stage} (page {page}). It cannot be imported.
parserError.duplicateStageFile: Two files cover stage {stage} of {division}. Upload a single PDF per stage.
parserError.stageSlotTaken: Could not determine the stage number on page {page}: both the page order ({byOrder}) and the previous stage + 1 ({byPrevious}) are already taken. Does the PDF have repeated or out-of-order stages?
parserError.partialRows: The file has rows we could not read ({detail}). It may be a format we don't support yet. Nothing was imported, to avoid leaving the match half-loaded — let me know the match name.

import.resultExisted: The match already existed — only stages were added.
